BrochureContent.Content:
Rare opportunity to buy a luxury four bedroom, detached house, on a quiet residential road in in Ballsbridge, Dublin 4, only a few minutes walk from all that the local area has to offer, including a variety of cafes, restaurants, grocery stores, private schools and Hebert Park. 

Location:

The location of this property is second to none, near the Dylan Hotel on St. Mary's Road, Baggot Street a few minutes walk and Dublin's Grafton street approximately 15/ 20 minute walk away.

The property enjoys a number of public transport links, including regular bus routes, Dart service at Lansdown Road and the AirCoach which all provide ease of access to the city centre, the many offices located at Grand Canal dock and Dublin Airport.

For the exercise enthusiast there are a a number of sports clubs, including UCD and David Lloyd Riverview and beautiful walking and running routes along the canal and Herbert Park.

Features include, formal living room, interconnecting into dining room, interconnecting into open plan kitchen, dining and family room with patio doors into South Facing garden with side access, utility room off kitchen, downstairs guest w.c. Upstairs there are four bedrooms, two large double bedrooms, both with en-suites and one with walk in dressing room also, guest double bedroom, single bedroom and family bathroom.

Other features include electric and gas heating, double glazed windows throughout, off street parking for one car and entire house totally refurbished including new bathrooms throughout.
For further inquiries please contact Alan Ferris on 0868114286. Viewing strictly by prior appointment only.
